recipes.title: Air Fryer Steak from Frozen (with fries)

items.i: frozen New York strip steak (about 10 oz, 1 inch thick)

steps: Take the steak straight from the freezer and cover it generously with coarse salt on both sides (and pepper if you like).
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 9 minutes, flip, and cook another 9 minutes for medium. For medium-rare, try 6 minutes per side at a higher heat.
Cook the frozen fries in the second basket (or after the steak) per the package instructions.
Rest the steak for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with the fries.
recipes.notes: Macros are estimated. The 9 + 9 minute timing (from the original Iced Coffee Hour hack) gave a pink, medium center; check with a thermometer, as times vary by air fryer and steak thickness.
